completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed frontal slight three-quarter full body portrait with overhead clearance.
reviewFindings: Four unique poses across six separate native frames: setup, row, rotate, press, lower, reverse rotation. The 6-to-1 transition completes lowering to thighs; frames6 and1 intentionally differ.
First rotation candidate changed body scale and was excluded. Selected retry retains the master framing.

Overhead frame visibly enlarges the dumbbells and lengthens the arms relative to the other poses. Equipment and anatomy checks remain unresolved; not approved for release. No repair of previously converted exercises was undertaken.

frames.caption: SET UP 1/6
frames.cue: Stand tall; hold light weights at thighs.

frames.caption: LEAD WITH ELBOWS 2/6
frames.cue: Raise elbows, keeping weights below them.

frames.caption: ROTATE UPWARD 3/6
frames.cue: Rotate weights upward without moving elbows.

frames.caption: PRESS OVERHEAD 4/6
frames.cue: Press overhead without arching your back.

frames.caption: LOWER TO SHOULDER HEIGHT 5/6
frames.cue: Lower slowly into the upright forearm position.

frames.caption: REVERSE THE ROTATION 6/6
frames.cue: Rotate down, then lower toward your thighs.

completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed front three-quarter view showing both outside knee pads and the full seated athlete; enclosed resistance tower behind the seat.
completeDraftSets.equipment: Real seated hip-abduction machine with backrest, fixed hand grips and two pivoting foot/pad assemblies; resistance routing enclosed, no invented visible cable travel.

primary: Gluteus medius and visible lateral glutes

reviewFindings: Three unique poses across six native frames: start, midway, wide, hold, midway return, start.
Initial master put one pad between the thighs; selected setup places both pads outside thighs.

The full-open near shoe changes orientation substantially and the far hand/handle contact is obscured. Pad/lever geometry and seated limb lengths need review; no equipment physics approval. Enclosed resistance tower does not expose cable routing or stack travel.

frames.caption: SET AND BRACE 1/6
frames.cue: Keep back supported; grip both handles.

frames.caption: OPEN YOUR HIPS 2/6
frames.cue: Push both knees outward against the pads.

frames.caption: REACH YOUR COMFORTABLE RANGE 3/6
frames.cue: Open comfortably without lifting your hips.

frames.caption: CONTROL THE WIDE POSITION 4/6
frames.cue: Squeeze outer glutes; keep your back supported.

frames.caption: RETURN SLOWLY 5/6
frames.cue: Bring knees inward slowly against resistance.

frames.caption: KEEP TENSION 6/6
frames.cue: Return to start without releasing the tension.
